messages:
maya: heads-up: running a dry-run for ash-13b-quant (catalog enable) now in staging. change window proposal still tomorrow 09:30-10:30 PDT. tagging this thread so infra + ops see preflight failures.
dan: saw the dry-run logs, deploy-bot preflight failed: quota_check=fail (gpu_quota). payload attached. wondering if we can split the enable across nodepools to avoid quota bump.
leo: can you paste the exact deploy-bot error snippet? last time it was because the pinlist exceeded per-catalog ACL size.
ops-oncall: error from deploy-bot: `preflight:quota_error: insufficient_gpu_quota: required=8, available=2`. also `manifest_warning: fallback_priority_list unknown_field`.
maya: ah that fallback field name again. our manifest generator uses `fallback_priority` while docs show `fallback_priority_list`. we'll standardize to `_list`.
leo: quick patch I'll try in staging: replace `fallback_priority` -> `fallback_priority_list` and split traffic targets across eu-west and us-west pools. patch below:
```json
{
  "catalog_entry": "ash-13b-quant",
  "fallback_priority_list": ["ash-13b-v1","legacy-13b","degen-6b"],
  "pin_list": ["acct:gov-ny","acct:enterprise-900"],
  "nodepool_targets": {"eu-west-1": 0.5, "us-west-2": 0.5}
}
```
ops-oncall: careful: deploy-bot manifest can't accept nested objects like `nodepool_targets` in this schema. please instead use `nodepool_target_list` as a flat list: `["eu-west-1:50","us-west-2:50"]`. deploy-bot will parse that.
dan: thanks, will convert. also infra: can we temporarily increase gpu quota in us-west-2 by +6 for the window? if not we need to postpone.
infra: we can request a quota bump but cloud ticket ET A is ~6h. we can instead do a staggered enable: 30% on existing capacity in us-west until bump approved, then complete shift. downside: longer canary timeline.
sre-oncall: telemetry gates we want set: p50 token latency baseline + 70ms OR request error rate + 1% OR model-accuracy quick-eval drop >= 2% triggers rollback. also add a hard OOM alarm.
maya: rollback procedure: ops-runbook step 4.b -> `deploy-bot rollback job-<id> --pin ash-13b-v1 --reason "telemetry_gate"`. ops-oncall make sure you have that in your escalation sequence.
ops-oncall: noted. dry-run follow-ups: 1) fixed the fallback field name 2) validated pin enforcement for `acct:gov-ny` 3) deploy-bot rejected nested nodepool_targets so we used `nodepool_target_list` and staging accepted it 4) metrics tag mismatch: metric uses `model.variant` not `model_variant` as observability expects. we'll translate in telemetry shim.
dan: can we add a safety to exclude routing to degen-6b for accounts in pin_list? previously degen fallback caused hallucination spikes for gov accounts.
leo: yes, add an `exclude_fallback_for_pins` entry: `["degen-6b"]` in the flat manifest. will validate in staging.
maya: new manifest snippet:
```json
{
  "catalog_entry": "ash-13b-quant",
  "fallback_priority_list": ["ash-13b-v1","legacy-13b"],
  "pin_list": ["acct:gov-ny","acct:enterprise-900"],
  "exclude_fallback_for_pins": ["degen-6b"],
  "nodepool_target_list": ["eu-west-1:50","us-west-2:50"]
}
```
infra: with that change, deploy-bot preflight now passes in staging but quota still fails in prod. decision: either request quota bump (delay) or stagger production cutover across two windows. proposal: move to TOMORROW 14:00 PDT and run staged shift 10%->40%->100% with 30m observation, allows extra time for quota request.
sre-oncall: +1 for later window. gives us time to extend telemetry dashboards and alerting.
ops-oncall: agree. also will prepare rollback quick-runbook and share support canary keys. canary keyset: `ash-canary-01..05`.
maya: will update release notes with new window, mention excluded fallback for pinned gov accounts, and include rollback command examples. i'll post to #release-notes by EOD.
dan: one more safety: add `traffic_fallback_sleep=60s` to catalog so if fallback triggers it won't immediately cascade. helps avoid repeated degen hops.
leo: added to manifest. staging runs green.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks_passed=6/6 in staging. prod quota_pending=true. queued job_id=job-2026-05-12-901 for TOMORROW 21:00Z pending infra quota. Reply with :eyes: when you've read.
maya: :eyes: will follow up when infra confirms quota.
infra: filed quota request ticket #Q-4821. ETA 4-8h. will update here.
sre-oncall: I'll prepare runbooks and a set of dashboards for net-new metric keys. once the telemetry shim is in prod we'll be ready.
maya: OK closing this dry-run thread. we'll reconvene after quota confirmation. thanks all for quick iter.
leo: thanks. closing. :thumbsup:
